definitions.gloss: safety harness; safety belt (for fall protection)
definitions.explanation: A belt or harness worn by workers at height to prevent falls, typically used in construction, maintenance, and other elevated work. In Japan, regulations have shifted from simple waist belts to full-body harnesses for work at greater heights.
An older term for a vehicle seat belt, now largely replaced by the loanword シートベルト in everyday usage.

examples.japanese: {高所|こうしょ}{作業|さぎょう}では{安全帯|あんぜんたい}を{着用|ちゃくよう}すること。
examples.english: Safety harnesses must be worn when working at heights.

examples.japanese: {安全帯|あんぜんたい}のフックを{確実|かくじつ}に{固定|こてい}してください。
examples.english: Please securely fasten the safety harness hook.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}の{改正|かいせい}により、{高|たか}さ6.75メートル{以上|いじょう}では{胴|どう}ベルト{型|がた}の{安全帯|あんぜんたい}が{使|つか}えなくなった。
examples.english: Due to a legal revision, waist-belt type safety harnesses can no longer be used at heights of 6.75 meters or more.

examples.japanese: {安全帯|あんぜんたい}を{締|し}めてください。
{飛行機|ひこうき}の{安全帯|あんぜんたい}のサインが{消|き}えた。
examples.english: The fasten seat belt sign on the airplane turned off.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{車|くるま}の{安全帯|あんぜんたい}をしない{人|ひと}も{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: In the past, many people didn't wear car seat belts.

notes:
Compound of {安全|あんぜん} ('safety') and {帯|たい} ('belt; band'). The primary modern usage is for fall-protection equipment in construction and industrial work. The seat-belt sense has been largely superseded by シートベルト.

REGULATORY NOTE:
- Since 2019, Japanese labor law requires full-body harnesses (フルハーネス{型|がた}) rather than simple waist belts ({胴|どう}ベルト{型|がた}) for work at heights above 6.75 meters
- The legal term has shifted from {安全帯|あんぜんたい} to {墜落制止用器具|ついらくせいしようきぐ} ('fall arrest equipment') in official regulations

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全帯|あんぜんたい}を{着用|ちゃくよう}する: to wear a safety harness
- {安全帯|あんぜんたい}を{装着|そうちゃく}する: to put on a safety harness
- {安全帯|あんぜんたい}の{点検|てんけん}: safety harness inspection
- フルハーネス{型|がた}{安全帯|あんぜんたい}: full-body harness type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シートベルト: seat belt — the standard modern term for vehicle seat belts
- ハーネス: harness — the loanword increasingly used for fall-protection equipment
- {命綱|いのちづな}: lifeline; safety rope — a rope that prevents falls, used alongside or instead of a harness
